title: B2. K for the Price of One (Hard Version)

legend: This is the hard version of this problem. The only difference is the constraint on k$$$k$$$ — the number of gifts in the offer. In this version: 2≤k≤n$$$2 \le k \le n$$$.
Vasya came to the store to buy goods for his friends for the New Year. It turned out that he was very lucky — today the offer "k$$$k$$$ of goods for the price of one" is held in store.

Using this offer, Vasya can buy exactly k$$$k$$$ of any goods, paying only for the most expensive of them. Vasya decided to take this opportunity and buy as many goods as possible for his friends with the money he has.

More formally, for each good, its price is determined by ai$$$a_i$$$ — the number of coins it costs. Initially, Vasya has p$$$p$$$ coins. He wants to buy the maximum number of goods. Vasya can perform one of the following operations as many times as necessary:

Vasya can buy one good with the index i$$$i$$$ if he currently has enough coins (i.e p≥ai$$$p \ge a_i$$$). After buying this good, the number of Vasya's coins will decrease by ai$$$a_i$$$, (i.e it becomes p:=p−ai$$$p := p - a_i$$$).

Vasya can buy a good with the index i$$$i$$$, and also choose exactly k−1$$$k-1$$$ goods, the price of which does not exceed ai$$$a_i$$$, if he currently has enough coins (i.e p≥ai$$$p \ge a_i$$$). Thus, he buys all these k$$$k$$$ goods, and his number of coins decreases by ai$$$a_i$$$ (i.e it becomes p:=p−ai$$$p := p - a_i$$$).
Please note that each good can be bought no more than once.

For example, if the store now has n=5$$$n=5$$$ goods worth a1=2,a2=4,a3=3,a4=5,a5=7$$$a_1=2, a_2=4, a_3=3, a_4=5, a_5=7$$$, respectively, k=2$$$k=2$$$, and Vasya has 6$$$6$$$ coins, then he can buy 3$$$3$$$ goods. A good with the index 1$$$1$$$ will be bought by Vasya without using the offer and he will pay 2$$$2$$$ coins. Goods with the indices 2$$$2$$$ and 3$$$3$$$ Vasya will buy using the offer and he will pay 4$$$4$$$ coins. It can be proved that Vasya can not buy more goods with six coins.
Help Vasya to find out the maximum number of goods he can buy.
input: The first line contains one integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤104$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases in the test.
The next lines contain a description of t$$$t$$$ test cases.

The first line of each test case contains three integers n,p,k$$$n, p, k$$$ (2≤n≤2⋅105$$$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$, 1≤p≤2⋅109$$$1 \le p \le 2\cdot10^9$$$, 2≤k≤n$$$2 \le k \le n$$$) — the number of goods in the store, the number of coins Vasya has and the number of goods that can be bought by the price of the most expensive of them.
The second line of each test case contains n$$$n$$$ integers ai$$$a_i$$$ (1≤ai≤104$$$1 \le a_i \le 10^4$$$) — the prices of goods.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ for all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case in a separate line print one integer m$$$m$$$ — the maximum number of goods that Vasya can buy.

legend.ai: 这是该问题的困难版本。唯一的区别在于 k$$$k$$$ 的约束，即优惠中商品的数量。在此版本中：2≤k≤n$$$2 \le k \le n$$$。
Vasya 来到商店，准备为他的朋友们购买新年礼物。事实证明，他非常幸运，因为今天商店正在进行“以一件商品的价格购买 k$$$k$$$ 件商品”的促销活动。
利用这一优惠，Vasya 可以购买任意 k$$$k$$$ 件商品，并且只需支付其中最贵商品的价格。Vasya 决定利用这个机会，用自己拥有的钱为朋友尽可能多地购买商品。
更正式地说，对于每件商品，其价格由 ai$$$a_i$$$ 决定，即购买它所需的硬币数。起初，Vasya 有 p$$$p$$$ 枚硬币。他想购买尽可能多的商品。Vasya 可以根据需要执行以下操作任意多次：
如果当前拥有足够的硬币(即 p≥ai$$$p \ge a_i$$$)，Vasya 可以购买编号为 i$$$i$$$ 的一件商品。购买该商品后，Vasya 的硬币数会减少 ai$$$a_i$$$(即变为 p:=p−ai$$$p := p - a_i$$$)。
如果当前拥有足够的硬币(即 p≥ai$$$p \ge a_i$$$)，Vasya 可以购买编号为 i$$$i$$$ 的一件商品，并另外选择恰好 k−1$$$k-1$$$ 件价格不超过 ai$$$a_i$$$ 的商品。因此，他会购买这 k$$$k$$$ 件商品，硬币数减少 ai$$$a_i$$$(即变为 p:=p−ai$$$p := p - a_i$$$)。
请注意，每件商品最多只能购买一次。

例如，如果商店现在有 n=5$$$n=5$$$ 件商品，它们的价格分别为 a1=2,a2=4,a3=3,a4=5,a5=7$$$a_1=2, a_2=4, a_3=3, a_4=5, a_5=7$$$，k=2$$$k=2$$$，且 Vasya 有 6$$$6$$$ 枚硬币，那么他可以购买 3$$$3$$$ 件商品。编号为 1$$$1$$$ 的商品将由 Vasya 不使用优惠购买，他将支付 2$$$2$$$ 枚硬币。对于编号为 2$$$2$$$ 和 3$$$3$$$ 的商品，Vasya 将使用优惠购买，并支付 4$$$4$$$ 枚硬币。可以证明，Vasya 不可能用 6 枚硬币购买更多商品。
帮助 Vasya 找出他最多可以买多少件商品。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤104$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)，表示测试用例的数量。
接下来的各行包含 t$$$t$$$ 个测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例的第一行包含三个整数 n、p、k$$$n, p, k$$$(2≤n≤2⋅105$$$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$，1≤p≤2⋅109$$$1 \le p \le 2\cdot10^9$$$，2≤k≤n$$$2 \le k \le n$$$)，分别表示商店中的商品数量、Vasya 拥有的金币数量，以及可以按照其中最贵商品的价格购买的商品数量。
每个测试用例的第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$(1≤ai≤104$$$1 \le a_i \le 10^4$$$)，表示商品的价格。
保证所有测试用例的 n$$$n$$$ 之和不超过 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，单独一行输出一个整数 m$$$m$$$，表示 Vasya 能购买的商品数量的最大值。
